title: Unit Event — Deep Dark for Light — Episode8 As Rivals

meta.Event Outline: On the last day of the workshop, Wonderlands×Showtime learn about the upcoming ArcLand Show Contest, and they decide to compete. Faced with the challenging role of a prince beset by despair, Tsukasa becomes keenly aware of the gap between himself and Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Well now, this is a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (This one...what was his name again? He's rough around the edges, and certainly didn't make much of an impression before...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (For a moment... I forgot to breathe.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (It's like there's a viscous, heavy fog rolling off the stage...)

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “I want to stay with you, Blesse! I want to see what our future together will be like!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “So... I won't ever let you give up on me!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “If you feel like everything is meaningless, then we'll find a meaning together!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “A beautiful rosebud... You'd never think it's a cursed flower.”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line:
“Come on, Blesse, pull it up!
Grab the flower...and pull!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line:
“Come on, give me your hands!
There...!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line:
“Blesse?! What's wrong, Blesse?!
We pulled up the flower!”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “Maybe the curse has sunk too deep...”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “If the despair of the curse has extinguished his will to live, then...”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “You promised to show me your secret getaway after this adventure! You said we'd boat down the river, camp out on an island and spend all night just talking...”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “You promised to love me forever and a day!”

rows.Speaker: Members of Other Troupe
rows.Line: That can't be the end...can it?

rows.Speaker: Members of Other Troupe
rows.Line: It's a show for ArcLand, so I wouldn't expect a downer ending, but...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (The very air is...oppressive, I'd say. And its source is...)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (Him. Without a single word, just by lying there.)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (They're calling for audience participation? In this atmosphere?)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You're not the kind of guy who just gives up like that, are you?!

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Blesse, do you hear that?! Someone is calling for you!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “They want you to stay with us! They don't want you to give up!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You can do it, Blesse! Don't let it beat you!

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Haha... I feel like I've woken from a terrible nightmare.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Forgive me. I was weak... I almost let the curse win.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “But... With you with me, I feel like I can take on anything. So...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Will you...stay with me, from now on?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “The rosebud opened! What a lovely scent...”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “If only you had shared your worries and pain with me from the start!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Let's think on it together. We can find a way for everyone to live in happiness.”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “And build a truly happy ending, with our own hands.”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Our story will end with, 'And so the prince and princess overcame their troubles, and everyone lived happily ever after!'”

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: And so, last but not least, we have the grand prize winners.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, we either won...or we're out of the running.)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Ah... Yes, yes. Congratulations to the members of the ArcLand team.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: It feels pretty self-congratulatory for an ArcLand team to win an ArcLand contest... But in the end, your performance was the most polished.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Especially you, Asahi Genbu. I got to see something pretty special today. Thanks for that.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Not at all! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The heart is not so easily marshaled...)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: This time around, we had a separate metric for success.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line:
Namely, “a show we'd like to see with a full house”.
And there was another show that fit that bill.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime. I think we'll have you play, as well.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Call it a Jury's Special Award, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Originally, the single winning group would perform for two weeks, but I'm sure the higher-ups will figure out a good way to split that time up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll also be granted the opportunity to perform here...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: The original point of this contest was to bring in outside talent, after all.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Oh, right. You there. What was your name, again?

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: That's all from me. You can take the mic back.

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: And so, with Mr. Sakaki's comments in mind, allow me to announce the final results.

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: Receiving the Jury's Special Award: Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: Though a tiny troupe with only four members, your passion for your craft created an immersive world upon the stage.

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: While somewhat irregular, Wonderlands×Showtime and the ArcLand team will both be given a run at the Center Theatre. We'll be in touch soon with the specifics.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Through our own efforts, we've stepped up onto a new stage. Isn't that right, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This result was only to be expected!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After all, we gave it our all, and we put on the greatest show we could!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So you say, but your eyes are a bit red.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all that hard work, I think a few happy tears are more than earned.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa! Do you need my hanky?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh! Don't fuss!
Let a man get misty!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem!
Listen to me, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's continue giving this show everything we have... In front of the actual audience, too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! Bye bye, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be throwing ourselves into intensive rehearsals starting tomorrow. Be sure to rest up while you can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Especially you, Tsukasa. You've been practicing a ton lately, so make sure you actually rest, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
But for now, farewell!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I wonder what it is...
The sunset looks so vibrant this evening.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It feels like today passed in a flash.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Asahi!
Is something the matter? You're still in costume...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... I wanted to talk to you, but our debriefing ran long. I didn't want to miss you, so I had to come running.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You did that for me?! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Your show today was amazing. Nene's singing and Emu's acrobatics have both gotten so much better, and Rui's direction was so impressive...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I almost forgot I was watching a play at all. It drew me in so well, I was on the edge of my seat.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm glad I got to see your performance today, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Ever since I first saw that night show at Phoenix Wonderland, I've considered you a talented and charming actor. But...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Seeing you perform today, I thought...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I don't want to lose to you.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I find your acting incredibly thrilling, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm always thinking, “What expression will he make next? What will he show us next?”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: At the same time, it leaves my chest burning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What you said... That burning in your chest. I believe it's the same sensation I've been feeling since the moment I met you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've always been blindingly bright in my eyes. So...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm overjoyed to finally stand on the same stage as you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And with my friends by my side, I will continue to fight to catch up to you.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Let's both give it our all in our next shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In that case, I'll have to redouble my efforts.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As his rival, as an actor, to bring both of us to greater heights!)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (He still has so much potential to improve. I can feel it.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (Why is that, I wonder? Is it because he's still growing? Or could it be...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And with my friends by my side, I will continue to fight to catch up to you.
